annotations.text: Source: Unit costs and yields from IndiGo FY2026 and Emirates 2025-26 primary filings, verified in data/manual/assumptions.csv. Stage lengths are great circle from OurAirports (CC0); network averages and load factors computed from DGCA. Cost elasticity to stage length is modelled, see docs/methodology.md

title.text:
The passengers India cannot see carry INR 28,916 to 56,712 crore, a third to two thirds of IndiGo's revenue
8.5M passengers a year, the gap between the Gulf's 50.9% of India's international sectors and roughly 40% of true origin-destination traffic, flown over a 6,731 km reference journey. Banded between the only two yields this project has verified. The O-D share cannot be verified at all, because IATA sells that data. Read it as the size of the contested pool, not a prize any one carrier captures
